scripts.text:
Wait a minute!
-You need to have an-
-^4d4dff'Eden Group Mark'^000000-
-to receive these missions.-
scripts.translation:
等一下！
-您需要持有-
-^4d4dff'乐园团徽章'^000000-
-才能领取这些任务。-

scripts.text: How can I be a member of the ^0000FFEden Group^000000?
scripts.translation: 如何成为^0000FF乐园团^000000的成员？

scripts.text:
::The Eden Group Missions
::are basically missions
::requested by
::people from all around the kingdom.
::We just categorize them.
scripts.translation:
::乐园团的任务
::基本上是王国各地人们
::提出的委托。
::我们只是负责分类。

scripts.text:
::In the Eden Group,
::we sorted out the missions
::according to the level of difficulty.
::According to this level,
::you can find
::missions that
::suit you.
scripts.translation:
::乐园团会按照任务难度
::对委托进行分类。
::您可以根据等级，
::寻找适合自己的任务。

scripts.text:
::When you are done,
::you can come back
::to the mission board.

::Then you will be
::rewarded!!
::Simple, isn't it!!
::No commission required!!
scripts.translation:
::然后您将获得
::奖励！！
::很简单，不是吗！！
::无需手续费！！

scripts.text:
::You can become a member
::of the Eden Group
::to ^0000FFLaime Evenor^000000,
::who is waiting on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
::向在一楼等候的
::^0000FF莱梅·艾文诺^000000申请
::加入乐园团。

scripts.text:
::If you become a member,
::you will get an
::"^006400Eden Group Mark^000000".
::Then you will be able
::to see the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::成为成员后，
::您会获得
::“^006400乐园团徽章^000000”，
::之后就能查看任务板了。

scripts.text: You must be within level 86-90 to accept these missions.
scripts.translation: 您的等级必须在86-90级之间才能接受这些任务。

scripts.text:
:: You cannot proceed in
:: ^0000FF{0} Hunting^000000.
:: The registration to the mission
:: is cancelled.

:: You added information
:: about the mission
:: ^0000FF{0} Hunting^000000
:: on the mission board.
:: You've got a
:: salutary experience.
scripts.translation:
::您已将^0000FF{0}狩猎^000000任务
::的信息登记到任务板上。
::您获得了宝贵的经验。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
There are several requests on this board.
scripts.translation:
[86～90级任务板]
这里有多个委托任务。

scripts.text:
^8B4513Turtle Island^000000.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
^8B4513海龟岛^000000
要狩猎哪种魔物？还是已经完成狩猎了？

scripts.text:
^8B4513Clock Tower Dungeon^000000.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
^8B4513钟楼地下城^000000
要狩猎哪种魔物？还是已经完成狩猎了？

scripts.text:
^8B4513Expansion Cities^000000
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
^8B4513扩展城镇^000000
要狩猎哪种魔物？还是已经完成狩猎了？

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
Here is a list of random requests to hunt monsters in other regions of Midgard.
Which monster will you hunt or have you finished hunting?
scripts.translation:
[86～90级任务板]
这里列出了米德加尔特其他地区的随机狩猎委托。
要狩猎哪种魔物？还是已经完成狩猎了？

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
You need to wait 3 hours before you can take this mission again.
scripts.translation:
[86-90级任务板]
您需要等待3小时才能再次接受此任务。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
Have you finished hunting all 30 {0}{1} yet?
scripts.translation:
[86-90级任务板]
您已经完成了30只{0}{1}的狩猎了吗？

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
You have completed the hunting.
Please accept this reward as a compensation.
scripts.translation:
[86-90级任务板]
您已完成狩猎。
请收下这份奖励作为补偿。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
Hunt 30 {0} monsters there and post your success on this board.
scripts.translation:
[86～90级任务板]
在那里狩猎30只{0}，并在此任务板上登记完成情况。

scripts.text:
[86-90 Mission Board]
When you have completed the mission, post it on this board and collect your reward.
scripts.translation:
[86～90级任务板]
完成任务后，请回到此任务板登记并领取奖励。
